services.department: Department of Revenue & Disaster Management
services.description: Official document certifying the annual household income of an individual or family for welfare schemes, school/college fee concessions, and government quotas.
services.eligibility: Resident of the state with verifiable legal income sources. Household income limits vary by scheme.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit application with ID and proof of residence. 2. Field verification by Village Administrative Officer (VAO) or Revenue Inspector. 3. Final issuance by Tahsildar.
services.source: National e-Governance Division (NeGD) Citizen Services Portal

services.department: Department of Revenue & District Administration
services.description: Official legal proof validating an applicant's continuous residency within a specific state, district, or taluk for education or employment reservations.
services.eligibility: Applicant must have continuously resided in the state/district for a minimum continuous duration (typically 5 to 7 years) or have ancestral domicile.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Fill citizen details. 2. Attach address and residence continuous proofs. 3. Revenue inspection and Tahsildar digital signature.
services.source: State Citizen Portal Public Manual (Rev-Dept 2026)

services.department: Department of Higher Education & Social Welfare
services.description: Financial assistance and tuition fee reimbursement for meritorious students from economically weaker sections and reserved social communities.
services.eligibility: Enrolled in recognized higher education institution (UG/PG/Diploma). Parent annual income within scheme caps (e.g., under INR 2,50,000 for full waiver).
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online student registration. 2. Verification of marksheets and institutional bonafide by college nodal officer. 3. Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) sanction.
services.source: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Operational Guidelines

services.department: Department of Social Welfare & Backward Classes
services.description: Government statutory certificate confirming the social community, caste, or tribe of the citizen to claim constitutional affirmative action benefits.
services.eligibility: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or Most Backward Class (MBC) as recognized in the state gazette.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Application submission with parental blood-relative records. 2. Spot enquiry and community register check. 3. Issuance by competent Sub-Divisional Magistrate or Tahsildar.
services.source: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment e-Services Manual

services.department: Department of Public Health & Municipal Administration
services.description: Primary legal record of a person's birth, including date, location, and parentage details vital for all civil rights and identity credentials.
services.eligibility: Any birth occurring within the jurisdiction of the municipal corporation, municipality, or village panchayat.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Hospital Form-1 birth intimation within 21 days of delivery. 2. Medical officer verification. 3. Issuance by Registrar of Births and Deaths.
services.source: Civil Registration System (CRS) - Office of the Registrar General

services.department: Department of Social Security & Disability Welfare
services.description: Monthly financial pension grant provided to senior citizens living in economic distress or without sufficient family financial support.
services.eligibility: Citizen aged 60 years or older. Family income below official Below Poverty Line (BPL) threshold. No adult earning member providing sustained support.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Application submission with proof of age and BPL card. 2. Verification of physical living condition and bank account. 3. Monthly DBT pension authorization.
services.source: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) Directive

services.department: Housing & Urban Development Department
services.description: Central and state government subsidized housing initiative providing pucca homes or construction assistance to homeless and kutcha-house dwellers.
services.eligibility: Citizen/family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Income category: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) or Low Income Group (LIG).
services.procedure_steps: 1. Household registration and geo-tagged home survey. 2. Land title verification. 3. Direct milestone fund transfer into beneficiary bank account.
services.source: Housing For All Urban & Rural Mission Guidelines 2026

services.department: Ministry of Education - Higher Education Financing Authority
services.description: Scheme offering full interest subsidy during the moratorium period (course period plus one year) on educational loans taken for professional/technical courses.
services.eligibility: Admitted to recognized technical/professional degree. Total parental/family income from all sources not exceeding INR 4,50,000 per annum.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Avail education loan from scheduled commercial bank. 2. Submit income certificate and bonafide to lending branch. 3. Ministry subsidy credit.
services.source: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS) Portal

services.department: Department of Revenue & Disaster Management (State)
services.description: Official statutory certificate verifying that an applicant is a native of the state by birth or ancestral lineage, required for state admissions, recruitment quotas, and welfare reservations.
services.eligibility: Citizen born in the state or residing permanently with parents possessing certified native domicile.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Apply online via State e-District / e-Seva portal. 2. VAO field enquiry and Revenue Inspector verification. 3. Approval and digital signature by Tahsildar.
services.source: National Portal of India - Citizen Services (services.india.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Public Health & Municipal Administration / CRS (State)
services.description: Statutory certificate recording the official date, place, and cause of death of an individual under the Registration of Births and Deaths Act 1969, vital for estate distribution, bank settlement, and insurance claims.
services.eligibility: Any death occurring within the administrative jurisdiction of the municipal corporation, municipality, or village panchayat.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Hospital Form-2 death intimation or family report within 21 days. 2. Cross-verification with cremation/burial authority. 3. Digital issuance by Registrar of Births and Deaths.
services.source: Civil Registration System (CRS) - Office of the Registrar General of India (crsorgi.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Revenue & District Administration (State)
services.description: Official government certificate establishing the direct legal successors of a deceased person for transferring movable/immovable assets, pensions, gratuity, and bank balances.
services.eligibility: Surviving direct legal heirs (Spouse, Children, Parents) of the deceased individual.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit online application on e-District portal. 2. Field enquiry by Village Administrative Officer (VAO) and Revenue Inspector. 3. Issuance by Tahsildar / Taluk Executive Magistrate.
services.source: State Revenue Administration & e-District Guidelines (edistrict.gov.in)

services.department: Commercial Taxes & Registration Department / Inspector General of Registration (State)
services.description: Official legal registration of marriage solemnized under the Hindu Marriage Act, Special Marriage Act, or Christian/Muslim personal marriage regulations, essential for passport updates, visas, joint banking, and legal status.
services.eligibility: Groom aged 21 or older, Bride aged 18 or older, neither party having a living spouse unless legally divorced.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online memorandum registration on State Inspectorate of Registration portal. 2. In-person appearance of couple with three adult witnesses before Sub-Registrar. 3. Issuance of legal marriage certificate.
services.source: Department of Registration and Stamps Citizen Charter (igreg.gov.in)

services.department: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), MeitY (Central)
services.description: Enrolment or demographic/biometric update of India 12-digit biometric unique identity number, functioning as primary digital proof of identity across India.
services.eligibility: Any individual who has resided in India for 182 days or more in the preceding 12 months.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Book appointment at Aadhaar Seva Kendra or apply demographic updates on myAadhaar portal. 2. Document upload and biometric verification. 3. Processing and physical PVC / e-Aadhaar generation.
services.source: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) (uidai.gov.in)

services.department: Income Tax Department, Ministry of Finance (Central)
services.description: Issuance of a 10-digit alphanumeric Permanent Account Number (PAN) used for direct taxation, banking operations, high-value asset purchases, and financial identity verification.
services.eligibility: Any Indian citizen, NRI, partnership firm, LLP, company, or minor entering financial transactions exceeding statutory limits.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit Form 49A on Protean NSDL or UTIITSL portal. 2. Paperless e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or document submission. 3. Dispatch of digital e-PAN and physical laminated PAN card.
services.source: Income Tax Department / Protean eGov Technologies (incometax.gov.in / onlineservices.nsdl.com)

services.department: Consular, Passport & Visa (CPV) Division, Ministry of External Affairs (Central)
services.description: Official international travel document issued by the Government of India certifying the holder identity and nationality for travel outside India.
services.eligibility: Citizen of India with clear police record and no adverse court prohibitions.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Fill online application on Passport Seva portal. 2. Book appointment and attend biometric/document verification at PSK or POPSK. 3. Police verification report and Speed Post dispatch.
services.source: Ministry of External Affairs - Passport Seva (passportindia.gov.in)

services.department: Election Commission of India (ECI) (Central)
services.description: Official photographic identity card issued to all eligible Indian citizens empowering them to exercise their democratic voting franchise in parliamentary and assembly elections.
services.eligibility: Indian citizen who has attained 18 years of age on the qualifying date of the calendar year and is an ordinary resident of the electoral constituency.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit Form 6 (fresh enrollment) or Form 8 (correction/shifting) on ECI Voters Portal. 2. Physical verification by Booth Level Officer (BLO). 3. Delivery of Electors Photo Identity Card (EPIC) by India Post.
services.source: Election Commission of India - Voter Services Portal (voters.eci.gov.in)

services.department: Motor Vehicles Department / Regional Transport Office (State)
services.description: Statutory licence permitting a qualified citizen to drive light motor vehicles, motorcycles, or commercial vehicles on public roads under the Motor Vehicles Act 1988.
services.eligibility: Minimum age 18 for LMV, 16 for gearless 50cc, 20 for commercial transport vehicles, with requisite physical/medical fitness.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online application and computer test for Learner Licence (LL) on Sarathi Parivahan. 2. Complete 30 days learning period. 3. Practical driving test at RTO automated test track and permanent DL issuance.
services.source: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways - Parivahan Sewa (parivahan.gov.in)

services.department: Transport Department / Regional Transport Office (RTO) (State)
services.description: Statutory registration of a motor vehicle under the Motor Vehicles Act, assigning an official registration number plate (HSRP) and Registration Certificate (RC).
services.eligibility: Citizen or legal entity owning a new or pre-owned motor vehicle registered in the respective state/RTO territorial jurisdiction.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Form 20 application generated via authorized vehicle dealer on Vahan portal. 2. Payment of road tax and registration fees. 3. Physical inspection by Motor Vehicle Inspector and RC issuance.
services.source: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways - Vahan Citizen Services (vahan.parivahan.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Protection (State)
services.description: Official statutory card issued to households to purchase subsidized essential commodities (rice, wheat, sugar, kerosene) under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
services.eligibility: Citizen households permanently residing in the state classified under Antyodaya (AAY), Priority Household (PHH), or Non-Priority (NPHH) groups.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit online application on State Civil Supplies portal. 2. Taluk Supply Officer (TSO) field inspection. 3. Digital printing and doorstep delivery of Smart Ration Card.
services.source: National Food Security Portal (NFSA) - Department of Food and Public Distribution (nfsa.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture (Central)
services.description: Central sector income support scheme providing INR 6,000 per year in three equal installments of INR 2,000 directly into the bank accounts of all landholding farmer families.
services.eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding registered in revenue records, excluding institutional landholders and income tax payees.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Self-registration on pmkisan.gov.in or via Common Service Centre (CSC). 2. Land record verification by District Agriculture Officer. 3. Aadhaar-based DBT payment transfer via NPCI.
services.source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare - PM-KISAN (pmkisan.gov.in)

services.department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (Central)
services.description: Government health assurance scheme offering cashless health cover of up to INR 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empaneled public and private hospitals.
services.eligibility: Low-income and vulnerable families identified based on SECC 2011 deprivation criteria or state NFSA beneficiary lists.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Verify eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or at empaneled hospital helpdesk. 2. Complete biometric Aadhaar e-KYC. 3. Immediate issuance of Ayushman Card (Golden Card).
services.source: National Health Authority - Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (pmjay.gov.in / beneficiary.nha.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Social Welfare & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (State)
services.description: Monthly social welfare pension paid to persons with severe disabilities living below the poverty line to support subsistence, healthcare, and assistive living.
services.eligibility: Citizen with minimum 40% permanent disability certified by government medical board, belonging to a BPL household.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Application submission with UDID card and bank passbook. 2. Revenue officer verification and medical board assessment. 3. Sanction and monthly DBT pension disbursement.
services.source: National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) - Ministry of Rural Development (nsap.nic.in)

services.department: Directorate of Employment and Training, Department of Labour (State)
services.description: Monthly financial allowance provided to educated unemployed youth registered with the state employment exchange to assist during job search and skill development.
services.eligibility: Educated youth (10th/12th/Degree passed) registered with the state employment exchange for at least 3 to 5 continuous years, family income within state threshold.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Apply online on State Employment Exchange portal. 2. Verification of live registration card and non-employment status. 3. Quarterly allowance credit to bank account.
services.source: Directorate of Employment and Training Citizen Charter (State Labour Dept)

services.department: Ministry of Labour & Employment / State Unorganised Workers Welfare Board (State)
services.description: Registration of unorganized workers creating a comprehensive social security registry to extend welfare benefits, accident insurance, healthcare access, and emergency financial relief.
services.eligibility: Any worker in the unorganized sector aged between 16 and 59 years who is not an income tax payee and not an EPFO/ESIC member.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Enrolment on e-Shram portal (eshram.gov.in) or via local CSC. 2. Biometric/OTP authentication with Aadhaar. 3. Instant generation of 12-digit UAN Labour Card.
services.source: Ministry of Labour and Employment - e-Shram Portal (eshram.gov.in)

services.department: State Building & Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Welfare Board (State)
services.description: Statutory welfare benefits including accident compensation, pension, maternity assistance, toolkits, and children educational scholarships for registered construction labourers.
services.eligibility: Construction worker aged between 18 and 60 years who has completed at least 90 days of construction work during the preceding 12 months.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit Form-V with 90-day engagement certificate to District Labour Office. 2. Spot enquiry by Labour Inspector. 3. Issuance of BOCW Identity Passbook and welfare enrollment.
services.source: Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (bocw.gov.in)

services.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) (Central)
services.description: Statutory paperless registration (Udyam Registration) providing micro, small, and medium businesses with priority sector bank lending, collateral-free credit, tender waivers, and government subsidies.
services.eligibility: Any enterprise engaged in manufacturing or service operations meeting statutory investment and turnover thresholds (Micro: Investment < INR 1 Cr & Turnover < INR 5 Cr).
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online self-declaration on official Udyam portal (udyamregistration.gov.in). 2. Automatic verification with PAN and GSTIN databases. 3. Issuance of permanent digital Udyam Certificate with QR code.
services.source: Ministry of MSME - Udyam Registration Portal (udyamregistration.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Revenue & District Administration (State)
services.description: Official statutory certification proving permanent resident status in the state by birth, ancestral heritage, or continuous 5-10 year domicile for state quota educational admissions and government recruitment.
services.eligibility: Citizen having permanent domicile in the state or continuous verifiable residence for the statutory period (typically 5 to 7 years) with ancestral ties.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online application via State e-District / e-Seva portal. 2. Field inquiry by Village Administrative Officer (VAO) and Revenue Inspector. 3. Final digital approval by Tahsildar.
services.source: National Portal of India - Domicile / PRC Services (services.india.gov.in)

services.department: State Police Department / Executive Magistrate (State)
services.description: Statutory verification certificate issued after background police record and criminal antecedent check, essential for government employment, university admissions, and international visa clearances.
services.eligibility: Any resident citizen with clean criminal record and verifiable identity credentials within the police jurisdiction.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Apply online on State Police Citizen Portal. 2. Station House Officer (SHO) physical field inquiry and criminal database verification. 3. Digitally signed clearance issued by Superintendent of Police or Tahsildar.
services.source: State Police Citizen Services Portal (citizen.police.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Revenue & District Administration (State)
services.description: Official certificate issued by the competent revenue authority certifying that the applicant is presently unemployed, required to claim government welfare allowances, exam fee waivers, and subsidized training loans.
services.eligibility: Educated youth or citizen who is currently not gainfully employed in government, public sector, or formal private employment.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit application with education credentials and non-employment affidavit. 2. VAO field inquiry and employment exchange cross-verification. 3. Certificate approval by Tahsildar.
services.source: State Revenue Department & Citizen Services Directorate

services.department: Department of Backward Classes Welfare & Revenue Administration (State)
services.description: Official statutory certificate certifying that an OBC applicant family annual income from non-agricultural sources does not exceed the creamy layer cap (INR 8 Lakhs per annum), granting eligibility for 27% Central/State OBC reservations.
services.eligibility: Applicant belonging to a recognized OBC community whose parental gross annual income is below INR 8,00,000 for the last 3 consecutive financial years, excluding agricultural income.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit Form along with 3-year parental income proof and community certificate. 2. Verification of parental employment category (Class I/II service status). 3. Issuance of NCL certificate by Tahsildar.
services.source: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions (DoPT) / NCBC Guidelines (ncbc.nic.in)

services.department: Department of Revenue & Social Welfare (State)
services.description: Income and Asset Certificate granting 10% reservation in civil posts and educational admissions for Economically Weaker Sections among General Category citizens under the 103rd Constitutional Amendment.
services.eligibility: Citizen belonging to General Category (not covered under SC, ST, or OBC), gross family annual income below INR 8,00,000, and family not owning 5+ acres agricultural land or 1000+ sq ft residential flat.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Application submission with family asset and income details. 2. Revenue field inspection of residential premises and agricultural land. 3. Certificate issuance by Tahsildar or Sub-Divisional Magistrate.
services.source: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment - EWS Directive (socialjustice.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Backward Classes & Most Backward Classes Welfare (State)
services.description: Statutory certificate confirming that an applicant belongs to an Other Backward Class (OBC) recognized in the State or Central OBC gazette list for affirmative action.
services.eligibility: Must belong to an eligible backward caste/community officially gazetted in the State/Central list.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Application submission with parental community documents. 2. Spot enquiry and caste ledger verification by VAO. 3. Issuance by Tahsildar.
services.source: National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) (ncbc.nic.in)

services.department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department / Revenue Administration (State)
services.description: Constitutional certificate certifying membership in a Scheduled Caste community under the Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, essential for educational and employment reservations.
services.eligibility: Must belong to a recognized Scheduled Caste community as gazetted for the respective state.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online submission with blood-relative SC certificate. 2. Field enquiry by Revenue Inspector and local village inspection. 3. Certificate approval by Tahsildar / Zonal Deputy Tahsildar.
services.source: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (socialjustice.gov.in)

services.department: Tribal Welfare Department / Revenue Divisional Administration (State)
services.description: Statutory tribal identity certificate issued after stringent genealogical and anthropological verification, mandated by the Supreme Court of India.
services.eligibility: Citizen belonging to a notified Scheduled Tribe community residing in notified tribal or scheduled areas.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Application submission with ancestral revenue and school records. 2. Anthropological enquiry and District Vigilance Committee scrutiny. 3. Final issuance strictly by Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) / Sub-Collector.
services.source: Ministry of Tribal Affairs - Guidelines for ST Verification (tribal.nic.in)

services.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Ministry of Social Justice (Central)
services.description: National biometric-enabled Unique Disability ID (UDID) Card creating a single verifiable digital document for persons with disabilities across all states and central welfare ministries.
services.eligibility: Any citizen having 40% or more permanent benchmark disability certified by a government district hospital medical board.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Register online on Swavlamban Portal (swavlambancard.gov.in). 2. Attend medical board clinical evaluation at assigned District Civil Hospital. 3. Assessment, percentage certification, and postal dispatch of plastic UDID Card.
services.source: Swavlamban Portal - DEPwD, Government of India (swavlambancard.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Social Welfare & District Collectorate (State)
services.description: Official identity card issued to elderly citizens aged 60 years or above, enabling priority queueing, transport fare concessions, healthcare packages, and state welfare allowances.
services.eligibility: Resident citizen who has completed 60 years of age on or before the date of application.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit application with proof of age and residential proof. 2. Verification of civil age credentials. 3. Issuance of laminated Senior Citizen ID Card.
services.source: Ministry of Social Justice & State Senior Citizen Welfare Code

services.department: Department of Revenue & Land Administration (State)
services.description: Official certificate assessing and certifying the net financial worth and property solvency of an individual or firm, essential for executing government public works contracts, tenders, and court bails.
services.eligibility: Citizen or business owning undisputed, unencumbered immovable properties evaluated by authorized revenue/engineering valuers.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit property registered deeds, EC, and valuation report. 2. Revenue Inspector site inspection and encumbrance check. 3. Solvency sanction by Tahsildar or District Collector.
services.source: State Revenue Standing Orders - Solvency Rules

services.department: Department of Registration & Stamps / Inspector General of Registration (State)
services.description: Official record issued in Form 15 or 16 documenting all registered legal transactions, sales, mortgages, leases, or court attachments on a specified parcel of property over a defined time period (up to 30+ years).
services.eligibility: Any property owner, prospective buyer, legal heir, or financial institution seeking property transaction history.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Search property via Survey Number, Sub-division, and Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) on State Registration portal. 2. Online search fee payment. 3. Digitally signed Form 15 EC download.
services.source: Inspector General of Registration & Stamps Portal (igreg.gov.in)

services.department: Department of Revenue & Survey and Settlement (State)
services.description: Official land title deed record issued by the Revenue Department recording the legal owner of an agricultural or residential land plot, including transfer/mutation of patta following purchase or inheritance.
services.eligibility: Legal purchaser, gift recipient, or lawful heir of a registered land parcel with valid registered title deeds.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit Patta Transfer application on State Land Records / e-Services portal. 2. Field survey and subdivision verification by Village Surveyor. 3. Tahsildar approval and generation of updated digital Patta.
services.source: Directorate of Survey and Land Records (eservices.tn.gov.in / state land portal)

services.department: Department of Revenue & Land Administration (State)
services.description: Certified extract of Village Revenue Register specifying land classification (Wet/Dry), survey number, extent in hectares, revenue tax assessment (Chitta), and seasonal crop cultivation details (Adangal).
services.eligibility: Landholding farmer, property owner, or agricultural loan applicant.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Select District, Taluk, Village, and Survey Number on State Land Records Portal. 2. Instant verification against digitised revenue database. 3. Instant download of digitally certified Chitta/Adangal extract.
services.source: AnyROR / Tamil Nilam / MeeBhoomi / Bhulekh State Land Portals

services.department: Directorate of Municipal Administration / Urban Local Bodies (Local/State)
services.description: Annual municipal property tax assessment and statutory tax receipt payment for residential, commercial, or industrial buildings within Municipal Corporation, Municipality, or Town Panchayat limits.
services.eligibility: Owner or lawful occupant of any building or vacant land within the urban local body jurisdiction.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Enter Property Assessment Number or Door Number on Urban Local Body portal. 2. Verify annual rental value, plinth area, and tax dues. 3. Pay online via payment gateway and generate receipt.
services.source: Directorate of Municipal Administration Citizen Services Portal

services.department: Town & Country Planning Directorate / Municipal Planning Authority (Local/State)
services.description: Statutory planning permission and building permit required prior to undertaking any residential, commercial, or industrial construction under the Town and Country Planning Act and Municipal Building By-Laws.
services.eligibility: Landowner or authorized builder with clear legal title, patta, and proposed architectural drawings compliant with Floor Space Index (FSI) regulations.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online application via Single Window Building Approval Portal. 2. Automated scrutiny of AutoCAD drawings by scrutiny engine. 3. Site inspection by Town Planning Officer and permit issuance.
services.source: Directorate of Town and Country Planning (DTCP) Single Window Portal

services.department: Municipal Corporation / Town Panchayat Health Department (Local Body)
services.description: Mandatory municipal operational licence certifying that a commercial business, retail shop, food outlet, or trade establishment complies with public health, safety, and fire norms within local body limits.
services.eligibility: Any business operator, retailer, hotelier, or trader establishing commercial activity within municipal boundaries.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Apply online via Urban Local Body Trade Portal. 2. Sanitary Inspector / Health Officer site inspection. 3. Payment of trade fee and digital issuance of Trade Licence certificate.
services.source: Municipal Corporation Public Health & Trade Licence Regulations

services.department: Department of Labour & Employment (State)
services.description: Statutory registration of shops, commercial establishments, software/IT companies, and restaurants regulating employment conditions, work hours, wage payments, and worker safety under the State Shops and Establishments Act.
services.eligibility: Any employer or enterprise opening a commercial premises or engaging employees in commercial operations.
services.procedure_steps: 1. File Form-A online on State Labour Single Window Portal. 2. Upload employer identity, establishment photos, and employee roster. 3. Instant auto-generation of Form-C Registration Certificate.
services.source: State Labour Department Single Window Portal (labour.gov.in)

services.department: Commercial Taxes Department / Municipal Corporation (State)
services.description: Statutory tax registration required for employers, self-employed professionals (doctors, lawyers, chartered accountants, architects), and traders paying half-yearly professional tax under State Municipal Acts.
services.eligibility: Any professional carrying on business, trade, or profession, and every employer employing salaried staff within the state.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online enrolment via Commercial Taxes / Municipal Corporation Portal. 2. Entry of turnover or employee salary tiers. 3. Generation of Professional Tax Assessment Certificate.
services.source: State Commercial Taxes & Municipal Professional Tax Directorate

services.department: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) / Chief Inspector of Factories (State)
services.description: Statutory manufacturing licence issued under the Factories Act 1948 ensuring occupational health, safety, machinery safeguards, and welfare facilities for manufacturing units employing 10+ workers with power (or 20+ without power).
services.eligibility: Manufacturing enterprise meeting statutory employee threshold and power consumption criteria.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit plant layout drawings and Form-1 for site clearance on Single Window Portal. 2. Industrial safety inspection by Joint Director of Industrial Safety. 3. Grant of Form-4 Factory Licence.
services.source: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) (dish.gov.in)

services.department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), MoHFW (Central/State)
services.description: Mandatory 14-digit food licence/registration issued under the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 regulating the manufacture, storage, distribution, sale, and import of food items to ensure food safety.
services.eligibility: Any Food Business Operator (FBO), petty hawker, restaurant, cloud kitchen, food manufacturer, or dairy processing unit.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Online submission on Food Safety Compliance System (FoSCoS - foscos.fssai.gov.in). 2. Food Safety Officer (FSO) physical inspection of kitchen/plant. 3. Issuance of 14-digit FSSAI Licence with QR code.
services.source: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India - FoSCoS (foscos.fssai.gov.in)

services.department: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) / CBIC, Ministry of Finance (Central)
services.description: Mandatory 15-digit alphanumeric Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN) issued to businesses engaged in intra-state or inter-state supply of goods and services exceeding turnover thresholds.
services.eligibility: Businesses with aggregate turnover exceeding INR 40 Lakhs (goods) or INR 20 Lakhs (services), e-commerce sellers, or inter-state taxable suppliers.
services.procedure_steps: 1. Submit Part A & B of Form GST REG-01 on GST Common Portal (gst.gov.in). 2. Complete Aadhaar biometric/OTP authentication. 3. System approval and generation of Form GST REG-06 Registration Certificate.
services.source: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) (gst.gov.in)

services.department: Employees Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Ministry of Labour (Central)
services.description: Central social security services managing retirement savings, employee pension scheme (EPS), provident fund withdrawals, advance advances, and e-Nomination for formal sector workers.
services.eligibility: Salaried employees working in establishments with 20 or more persons earning up to INR 15,000/month (or voluntary coverage).
services.procedure_steps: 1. Log into EPFO Member Unified Portal with UAN and password. 2. Verify KYC (Aadhaar, PAN, Bank IFSC). 3. Submit online PF transfer, advance, or settlement claim with Aadhaar OTP authentication.
services.source: Employees Provident Fund Organisation - Member Unified Portal (epfindia.gov.in)

services.department: Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour (Central)
services.description: Statutory social security and health insurance scheme providing comprehensive medical care, sickness benefits, maternity benefits, and disablement benefits to insured employees and their dependants.
services.eligibility: Employees in factories and commercial establishments with 10 or more workers earning gross wages up to INR 21,000 per month (INR 25,000 for PwD).
services.procedure_steps: 1. Employer registers unit online on Shram Suvidha / ESIC portal. 2. Enrol employees with Aadhaar and family details. 3. Generation of biometric e-Pehchan Card for cashless hospital treatment.
services.source: Employees State Insurance Corporation Portal (esic.gov.in)

services.department: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology / Department of Higher Education (Central)
services.description: Central sector and centrally sponsored scholarships implemented on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) providing full fee reimbursement and monthly stipends for college and university students.

services.procedure_steps: 1. Student One-Time Registration (OTR) via NSP portal. 2. Application submission and online document upload. 3. Dual-level institutional nodal officer and state officer e-verification, followed by DBT disbursement.

documents.document_name: Affidavit of Non-Salaried Income

documents.document_name: Parental Income Certificate

documents.document_name: Disability Certificate (UDID Card)

documents.document_name: Father or Blood Relative Community Certificate

documents.document_name: Ration Card / Family Smart Card

documents.description: Court or Executive Magistrate sanction order authorizing registration of delayed birth.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory if birth event is being registered after 30 days up to 1 year or more following date of birth.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Proof of identity and demographic record.

documents.document_name: Age Proof (Birth Certificate / Voter ID / Medical Age Certificate)

documents.document_name: BPL Ration Card or Indigent Income Certificate

documents.document_name: Death Certificate of Husband

documents.condition_rule: Mandatory strictly for applicants applying under the Widow / Destitute Women Pension category.

documents.document_name: Affidavit of Destitution / No Earning Adult Son

documents.document_name: Bank Account Details with IFSC

documents.document_name: Non-Encumbrance Certificate (EC)
documents.description: Certificate from Sub-Registrar confirming property has no legal mortgages or court liens.

documents.source: Housing For All Urban & Rural Mission Guidelines 2026

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Student & Co-borrower Parent
documents.description: Biometric proof of identity for student borrower and parent guarantor.
documents.source: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS) Portal

documents.document_name: Entrance Examination Scorecard / Merit Admission Letter
documents.description: Scorecard of national/state exam (JEE, NEET, GATE, CAT, CET) or merit allotment letter from central counseling.

documents.document_name: Official Fee Structure on College Letterhead

documents.document_name: Annual Family Income Certificate (< INR 4.5 Lakhs)

documents.source: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS) Portal

documents.document_name: Existing Education Loan Sanction Letter & Account Statement
documents.description: Formal loan sanction letter issued by a scheduled commercial bank outlining principal and disbursed tranche.

documents.source: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS) Portal

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
documents.description: 12-digit biometrically linked unique identity card validating demographic details.
documents.source: National Portal of India - Citizen Services

documents.document_name: Proof of Birth (Birth Certificate or SSLC/10th Marksheet)
documents.description: Statutory certificate verifying place of birth within the state or school education in the state.
documents.source: Registration of Births and Deaths Act / State Education Board

documents.document_name: Proof of Continuous Residence (Ration Card / Voter ID / Land Tax)
documents.description: Documentary evidence showing continuous long-term family habitation within the state.

documents.document_name: Recent Passport Size Photograph
documents.description: Clear frontal colour photograph taken within the last 6 months.

documents.document_name: Parents Nativity Certificate or School Transfer Certificate
documents.description: Official nativity certificate or educational record of mother/father establishing ancestral state lineage.
documents.condition_rule: Required if applicant was born outside the state or is claiming native status through parental lineage.

documents.document_name: Registered Property Title Deed / Ancestral Land Document
documents.description: Sub-registrar registered title deed or ancestral revenue patta evidencing permanent roots in the state.
documents.condition_rule: Required when establishing permanent native domicile based on ancestral family landholding.

documents.document_name: Hospital Death Report / Form-2 Death Intimation
documents.description: Medical death report (Form-4 / 4A) issued by the attending doctor or hospital at time of demise.
documents.source: Civil Registration System (CRS) - Office of the Registrar General of India

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of the Deceased Person
documents.description: Original or copy of Aadhaar card of the deceased for statutory identity cancellation and national record.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card / Photo ID of Informant / Next of Kin
documents.description: Government photo identity card of the family member or person reporting the death.

documents.document_name: Crematorium / Burial Ground Acknowledgement Receipt
documents.description: Official receipt issued by the municipal or village cremation/burial ground supervisor.

documents.description: Certified copy of police First Information Report and medical autopsy report.

documents.document_name: Executive Magistrate Sanction Order for Delayed Death Registration
documents.description: Sanction order issued by Sub-Divisional Magistrate or Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO).
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory if death registration is delayed beyond 30 days up to 1 year or more under Section 13(3) of RBD Act.
documents.source: Registration of Births and Deaths Act 1969

documents.document_name: Original Death Certificate of the Deceased Person
documents.description: Statutory death certificate issued by the Municipal Corporation or Village Panchayat registrar.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Cards of All Surviving Legal Heirs
documents.description: Biometric identity cards of all lawful direct successors (spouse, sons, daughters, mother).

documents.document_name: Family Ration Card / Smart Card
documents.description: Civil supplies ration card establishing family composition and genealogical relation to the deceased.

documents.document_name: Notarized Legal Heir Self-Declaration Affidavit
documents.description: Sworn affidavit signed before a Notary Public detailing complete list of surviving lawful heirs and declaring no other heirs exist.

documents.document_name: Marriage Certificate or Service Register Record
documents.description: Document validating marriage with deceased if spouse name is not updated on civil identity credentials.

documents.document_name: No-Objection Certificate (NOC) from Other Legal Heirs

documents.condition_rule: Required when one heir is applying on behalf of others to claim family pension, gratuity, or compassionate appointment.

documents.document_name: Proof of Age of Bride and Groom (10th Marksheet / Birth Certificate)
documents.description: Document confirming Bride has attained 18 years and Groom has attained 21 years of age.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Cards of Both Husband and Wife
documents.description: Personal identity cards with up-to-date demographic records.

documents.document_name: Wedding Invitation Card / Religious Solemnization Receipt
documents.description: Printed marriage invitation card or solemnization certificate issued by Temple, Church, or Qazi (Nikahnama).

documents.document_name: Joint Wedding Photographs & Passport Photos
documents.description: Original joint wedding photograph showing couple solemnizing marriage rituals plus individual passport photos.

documents.document_name: Identity & Address Proofs of Three Adult Witnesses
documents.description: Aadhaar Cards / Voter IDs / Passports of three adult witnesses who attended the marriage ceremony.

documents.document_name: Court Divorce Decree or Death Certificate of Previous Spouse
documents.description: Certified copy of civil court dissolution order or municipal death certificate of deceased former partner.

documents.document_name: NOC / Single Status Certificate from Foreign Embassy
documents.description: No-Objection Certificate and single marital status certification from the respective foreign embassy or consulate.

documents.document_name: Proof of Identity (PoI) Document

documents.document_name: Proof of Date of Birth (DoB)
documents.description: Recognized birth proof (Birth Certificate issued by Registrar of Births, SSLC Marksheet, or Indian Passport).

documents.document_name: Medical Exception Certificate for Biometric Exemption
documents.description: Medical certificate issued by government civil surgeon documenting missing fingers, amputation, or corneal blindness.
documents.condition_rule: Required for citizens with physical disabilities or severe hand anomalies unable to provide standard fingerprint biometrics.

documents.document_name: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
documents.description: Government photo identification document establishing applicant legal identity and name.

documents.document_name: Proof of Address (Aadhaar / Utility Bill / Bank Statement)

documents.document_name: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / Matriculation / Aadhaar)
documents.description: Recognized document certifying date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format matching identity records.

documents.document_name: Recent Passport Size Colour Photographs (2 Copies)
documents.description: Two identical 3.5 cm x 2.5 cm colour photographs with white background and clear facial contrast.

documents.document_name: Representative Assessee ID & Address Proof

documents.document_name: Marriage Certificate or Gazette for Surname Change
documents.description: Marriage certificate or official gazetted surname change publication.

documents.document_name: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / SSLC Marksheet / Aadhaar)

documents.document_name: Active Mobile Number Linked with Aadhaar
documents.description: Mobile number registered with UIDAI for real-time OTP authentication during worker onboarding.

documents.document_name: Bank Account Passbook (Account Number & IFSC)
documents.description: Bank passbook or cancelled cheque for direct financial credit of social security benefits and accidental relief.

documents.document_name: Self-Declaration of Occupation in Unorganized Sector
documents.description: Self-declaration declaring engagement as domestic worker, street vendor, driver, farm labourer, or artisan, and non-membership in EPFO/ESIC.

documents.document_name: Nominee Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
documents.description: Photo identity card of designated nominee with relationship and date of birth details.
documents.condition_rule: Required to nominate legal beneficiary for INR 2,00,000 accidental death/disability insurance cover under PMSBY.

documents.document_name: Skill / Vocational Training Certificate
documents.description: Certificate from National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) or recognized state vocational training center.
documents.condition_rule: Optional, required if registering for state skill upgradation stipends and free tool kit subsidies.

documents.document_name: 90 Days Construction Work Certificate (Form-V)
documents.description: Certificate issued by registered contractor, trade union, or Assistant Labour Commissioner verifying 90 days construction work.
documents.source: Building & Other Construction Workers (RECS) Act 1996 Section 12

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Construction Worker
documents.description: Biometric unique identity card confirming worker identity.

documents.document_name: Age Proof (School Certificate / Voter ID / Aadhaar verifying 18-60 Years)
documents.description: Document establishing worker age between 18 and 60 years.

documents.document_name: Family Ration Card / Smart Card
documents.description: Civil supplies card establishing dependant family members eligible for marriage, medical, and maternity benefits.

documents.document_name: Bank Passbook with IFSC (Single Account)
documents.description: Copy of bank passbook for direct credit of welfare grants and educational stipends.

documents.document_name: Passport Size Photographs (3 Copies)
documents.description: Recent colour photographs for identity passbook and labour welfare identity card.

documents.document_name: Children Educational Bonafide / Enrollment Certificates
documents.description: Bonafide certificate issued by school/college principal confirming regular full-time study of worker child.
documents.condition_rule: Required when applying for BOCW Children Educational Scholarship, free laptops, or higher studies assistance.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Proprietor / Managing Partner / Director
documents.description: 12-digit Aadhaar card linked with active mobile number for biometric/OTP authorization on Udyam portal.

documents.document_name: PAN Card of the Enterprise / Proprietor
documents.description: Income Tax PAN card of proprietor (for proprietorship) or business PAN (for partnership/company).
documents.source: Ministry of MSME Gazetted Order on Mandatory PAN

documents.document_name: Business Address Proof (Electricity Bill / Rent Agreement / Property Tax)
documents.description: Utility bill, lease agreement, or municipal property tax receipt establishing commercial or manufacturing premises.

documents.document_name: Bank Account Details of Enterprise (Passbook / Cancelled Cheque)
documents.description: Bank statement or cancelled cheque showing business entity name, active account number, and IFSC code.

documents.document_name: National Industrial Classification (NIC) Activity Code
documents.description: 2-digit, 4-digit, or 5-digit NIC 2008 business activity classification identifying manufacturing/service scope.

documents.document_name: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN)
documents.description: 15-digit state GSTIN registration certificate issued under Central Goods and Services Tax Act 2017.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for enterprises operating in GST-liable categories or whose annual turnover exceeds statutory GST exemption thresholds.
documents.source: CGST Act 2017 / Ministry of MSME Circular

documents.document_name: Partnership Deed / Certificate of Incorporation (RoC)
documents.description: Sub-registrar registered partnership deed or Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) certificate of incorporation.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for Partnership Firms, LLPs, Private Limited Companies, or One Person Companies (OPC).

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
documents.description: 12-digit biometrically authenticated identity card verifying applicant name and demographic record.

documents.document_name: Proof of Continuous Residence (5 to 10 Years)
documents.description: Continuous documentary proof like Land Tax receipts, Voter List extracts, or Electricity Bills for minimum continuous statutory duration.

documents.document_name: School Transfer Certificate (TC) / Educational Proofs
documents.description: School/College TC or study certificates confirming continuous schooling in the state from primary to higher secondary level.

documents.document_name: Parents Domicile Certificate or Ancestral Land Deed
documents.description: Certified domicile certificate of father/mother or registered title deed showing ancestral family roots.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory if applicant claims domicile through parental ancestral origin rather than personal continuous residence.

documents.document_name: Notarized Domicile Self-Affidavit
documents.description: Sworn affidavit signed before an Executive Magistrate or Notary Public affirming permanent intention to reside in the state.

documents.document_name: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport)
documents.description: Government photo identification document confirming identity without discrepancies.

documents.document_name: Proof of Residential Address (Utility Bill / Rent Agreement)
documents.description: Valid address proof showing continuous residence within the local police station jurisdiction for at least 1 year.

documents.document_name: Passport Size Colour Photographs (3 Copies)
documents.description: Recent colour photographs with clear facial exposure.

documents.document_name: Letter of Intent / Requisition from Employer or Embassy
documents.description: Formal letter requesting character verification issued by government recruiter, embassy, or public agency.
documents.condition_rule: Required if character verification is specifically demanded for overseas visa, defense, or PSU employment.

documents.document_name: Character Reference Letters from Two Gazetted Officers
documents.description: Signed certificates of good moral character from two respectable gazetted officers or ward councilors not related to applicant.
documents.condition_rule: Required when applying through Executive Magistrate or District Collectorate channels.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
documents.description: Personal biometric identity document verifying citizen age and residence.

documents.document_name: Educational Certificates (SSLC / HSC / Degree)
documents.description: Original educational marksheets and degree certificates establishing highest qualification attained.

documents.document_name: State Employment Exchange Live Registration Card
documents.description: Live registration card showing continuous active enrollment on the National Career Service (NCS) or state exchange.

documents.document_name: Notarized Affidavit of Non-Employment
documents.description: Sworn affidavit affirmed on non-judicial stamp paper stating applicant does not hold any formal public or private salaried job.

documents.document_name: Family Smart Ration Card
documents.description: Civil supplies ration card showing household composition and dependent status.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
documents.description: Biometric identity card verifying personal demographic data.
documents.source: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances & Pensions (DoPT)

documents.document_name: Father or Mother Community Certificate (OBC)
documents.description: State-issued community certificate proving parent belongs to an eligible backward class recognized in central/state lists.

documents.document_name: Parents Income Proof for Last 3 Financial Years (ITR / Form 16 / Salary Slip)
documents.description: Income Tax Returns, Form 16, or salary statements proving gross non-agricultural parental income is under INR 8 Lakhs/year.

documents.document_name: Agricultural Landholding Certificate from Tahsildar
documents.description: Revenue certificate verifying agricultural landholding does not exceed the statutory ceiling limit.
documents.condition_rule: Required if parents own agricultural land to substantiate exclusion from creamy layer wealth criteria.

documents.document_name: Self-Declaration Affidavit of Non-Creamy Layer Status
documents.description: Standard Annexure affidavit declaring family does not fall in the creamy layer as defined in DoPT OM No. 36012/22/93.

documents.document_name: Family Smart Ration Card
documents.description: Civil supplies card validating parentage and family living composition.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Cards of Applicant and All Family Members
documents.description: Biometric identity cards of all co-inhabiting family members for national verification.
documents.source: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (socialjustice.gov.in)

documents.document_name: Gross Annual Family Income Certificate (< INR 8 Lakhs)
documents.description: Revenue income certificate proving total family earnings from all sources is below INR 8 Lakhs for the preceding financial year.

documents.document_name: Agricultural Landholding Records / Patta
documents.description: Land records proving family does not own 5 acres or more of agricultural land anywhere in India.

documents.document_name: Residential Flat / Plot Area Certificate
documents.description: Property documents confirming residential flat is under 1,000 sq ft or residential plot is under 100/200 sq yards.

documents.document_name: Self-Declaration of Non-Coverage under SC/ST/OBC
documents.description: Sworn affidavit affirming applicant belongs to General Category and is not eligible for SC, ST, or OBC reservation.

documents.document_name: Bank Statements of All Earning Family Members (1 Year)
documents.description: Bank account statements showing financial flows of family members.
documents.condition_rule: Required if family members have informal or business income without formal ITR filings.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
documents.description: Government photo identification document establishing applicant legal identity and name.

documents.document_name: School Transfer Certificate (TC) Recording OBC Community
documents.description: School or college TC explicitly recording the community and sub-caste recorded at the time of admission.

documents.document_name: Father or Blood Relative OBC Community Certificate
documents.description: Community certificate of father, real brother, sister, or paternal grandfather issued by revenue authority.

documents.document_name: Family Smart Ration Card
documents.description: State civil supplies smart card establishing genealogical relationship to certified relatives.

documents.document_name: Local VAO / Village Administrative Verification Report
documents.description: Field enquiry report confirming long-standing local community status.
documents.condition_rule: Required if blood relative certificates were issued in another district or state jurisdiction.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
documents.description: Biometric identity card verifying personal identity and residential location.

documents.document_name: School Leaving Certificate / TC with SC Entry
documents.description: School TC recording the Scheduled Caste community of applicant at initial primary schooling.

documents.document_name: Father or Real Sibling SC Community Certificate
documents.description: Permanent community certificate of paternal family members issued by competent Tahsildar.

documents.document_name: Family Smart Ration Card
documents.description: Ration card confirming applicant family composition and parental lineage.

documents.document_name: Revenue Inspector Spot Enquiry Report
documents.description: Formal inquiry report validating hereditary community status in native habitation.
documents.condition_rule: Required in absence of direct parental certificates or upon interstate migration.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
documents.description: Biometric identity document establishing applicant identity and tribal area residence.

documents.document_name: Paternal Blood Relative ST Certificate (RDO Issued)
documents.description: Statutory ST certificate of father, paternal uncle, or grandfather issued strictly by Sub-Collector / RDO.
documents.source: Supreme Court Mandate on ST Issuance

documents.document_name: Primary School Admission Register Extract
documents.description: Certified extract of early school admission register recording hereditary tribal classification.

documents.document_name: District Vigilance Committee Anthropological Scrutiny Report
documents.description: Comprehensive anthropological scrutiny report verifying ethnic customs, dialect, and tribal roots.

documents.document_name: Family Smart Ration Card
documents.description: Civil supplies smart card proving family genealogical ties to certified tribal elders.

documents.document_name: Forest / Tribal Habitation Domicile Certificate
documents.description: Certificate from Forest Range Officer or Village Headman proving long-standing residence in scheduled tribal settlement.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory if applicant resides within Scheduled Tribal Areas or hill tracts.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Person with Disability
documents.description: Biometric identity card required for digital e-KYC and national de-duplication on Swavlamban Portal.
documents.source: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (swavlambancard.gov.in)

documents.document_name: Colour Photograph showing Visible Disability
documents.description: Full length or frontal colour photograph clearly displaying visible physical disability condition.

documents.document_name: Medical Evaluation Report from Government Civil Hospital
documents.description: Clinical assessment report issued by government district medical specialist detailing disability degree.
documents.source: Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016

documents.document_name: Diagnostic Clinical Test Reports (Audiogram / IQ / MRI)
documents.description: Specialized medical tests: Audiogram for hearing loss, IQ assessment for intellectual disability, or ophthalmic report for blindness.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for sensory, cognitive, intellectual, or non-visible neurological disabilities.

documents.document_name: Proof of Residential Address (Voter ID / Ration Card / Electricity Bill)
documents.description: Address verification document establishing residence in the medical district jurisdiction.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card (Verifying Age 60+)
documents.description: Biometric identity card confirming applicant has attained 60 years of age.
documents.source: Department of Social Welfare Citizen Charter

documents.document_name: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate / Passport / Voter ID)
documents.description: Statutory age verification document establishing date of birth matching identity records.

documents.document_name: Proof of Residence in the State (Ration Card / Utility Bill)
documents.description: Document certifying continuous residence within the state.

documents.document_name: Blood Group Test Certificate
documents.description: Medical laboratory report certifying blood group for emergency medical care recording.

documents.document_name: Passport Size Colour Photographs (2 Copies)
documents.description: Recent colour photographs for laminated identity pass issuance.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card & PAN Card of Applicant
documents.description: Personal identity and income tax credentials of the applicant or firm partners.

documents.document_name: Registered Sale Deeds / Title Deeds of Immovable Properties
documents.description: Original registered deeds establishing absolute, undisputed ownership of properties offered for solvency evaluation.

documents.document_name: Latest Encumbrance Certificate (EC) for 13 to 30 Years
documents.description: Non-encumbrance certificate issued by Sub-Registrar verifying properties are free from mortgages or liens.

documents.document_name: Govt Approved Valuer / PWD Property Valuation Report
documents.description: Certified property valuation report signed by government-registered valuer or PWD Executive Engineer.

documents.document_name: Latest Property Tax / Land Revenue Tax Receipts
documents.description: Recent tax receipts confirming no municipal or land tax arrears exist on the evaluated properties.

documents.document_name: Notarized Affidavit of Free Title and Non-Pledge
documents.description: Sworn affidavit affirming properties are unencumbered, free from court attachments, and not pledged for other solvency guarantees.

documents.document_name: Registered Sale Deed / Title Document Copy
documents.description: Copy of previous registered sale deed, settlement deed, or partition deed establishing property identity.

documents.document_name: Accurate Property Schedule & Boundaries (North, South, East, West)
documents.description: Complete four-sided boundary details, survey number, sub-division, plot number, and village name.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card / Photo ID of Applicant
documents.description: Government photo identification document of person seeking search records.

documents.document_name: Latest Property Tax Receipt / Municipal Assessment Number
documents.description: Municipal assessment receipt connecting property to physical local body records.
documents.condition_rule: Recommended to verify house/door number linkages within urban local body limits.

documents.document_name: Registered Sale Deed / Settlement Deed in Applicant Name
documents.description: Certified copy of registered conveyance deed registered at the Sub-Registrar Office transferring ownership.
documents.source: Department of Revenue & Survey and Settlement

documents.document_name: Previous Owner Patta Copy / Chitta Ledger Extract
documents.description: Existing digital patta copy or village ledger record registered in vendor/ancestor name.

documents.document_name: Encumbrance Certificate (EC) from Date of Purchase
documents.description: Sub-Registrar EC verifying transaction registration and non-existence of third-party encumbrances.

documents.description: Village cadastral map sketch depicting land dimensions, survey stones, and proposed subdivision line.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory if patta transfer involves sub-division of a larger survey number.

documents.document_name: Legal Heir Certificate & Consent NOC of Co-heirs
documents.description: Statutory legal heir certificate and sworn consent affidavits.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory if patta mutation is claimed by inheritance following demise of original registered owner.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant
documents.description: Biometric identity credential for digital landholder linking.

documents.document_name: Survey Number and Sub-Division Number Details
documents.description: Accurate revenue survey number and sub-division as recorded in village revenue map.

documents.document_name: Patta Number or Registered Landowner Name
documents.description: Patta account number or registered titleholder name as recorded in the district revenue register.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Landowner
documents.description: Identity verification document establishing lawful land ownership interest.

documents.document_name: Seasonal Crop Cultivation Declaration
documents.description: Self-declaration of standing agricultural crops, irrigation source, and harvested yield.
documents.condition_rule: Required for Adangal crop entries when claiming agricultural insurance or crop disaster relief.

documents.document_name: Property Assessment Number / Old Tax Receipt
documents.description: Unique property identification code (PID) or receipt of previous half-year property tax settlement.

documents.document_name: Registered Title Deed / Sale Deed of Property
documents.description: Registered deed proving legal ownership of the residential or commercial building.

documents.document_name: Sanctioned Building Plan Copy or Completion Certificate
documents.description: Approved planning permit indicating sanctioned plinth area and structural floor details.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for fresh property tax assessment of newly constructed buildings.

documents.document_name: Electricity Meter Service Connection Card / Bill
documents.description: Recent electricity consumption bill showing consumer service connection number.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card of Property Owner
documents.description: Identity proof of titleholder.

documents.document_name: Registered Land Ownership Deed & Revenue Patta
documents.description: Registered title deeds along with computerized revenue patta showing undisputed ownership of plot.

documents.description: Detailed floor plans, elevation, sectional views, site plan, and key plan drawn to metric scale.

documents.description: Certificate affirming structural design compliance with Indian Standard seismic and wind load codes.

documents.document_name: Encumbrance Certificate (EC) for Past 13 Years
documents.description: Sub-Registrar EC proving plot is free from court attachments and mortgages.

documents.document_name: Fire and Rescue Services Department NOC
documents.description: No Objection Certificate from state fire authority affirming compliance with emergency egress and hydrants.

documents.document_name: Pollution Control Board Consent to Establish (CTE)

documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for industrial developments or commercial projects generating significant effluent/sewage.

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card & PAN Card of Proprietor / Partners
documents.description: Personal identity and taxation documents of business owners.

documents.document_name: Commercial Premises Property Tax Receipt or Rent Agreement
documents.description: Municipal property tax receipt of owned commercial shop or notarized tenancy lease agreement.

documents.document_name: Sanctioned Building Plan / Commercial Assessment Order
documents.description: Document verifying the premises is legally sanctioned for commercial trade operations.

documents.document_name: Owner No-Objection Certificate (NOC) for Trade
documents.description: Consent letter from building owner permitting specific trade activity on rented premises.
documents.condition_rule: Required if operating from rented or leased commercial accommodation.

documents.document_name: Fire Safety NOC from Fire Department
documents.description: Statutory fire safety certification verifying fire extinguishers and emergency exits.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for high-occupancy trades, hotels, restaurants, banquet halls, fireworks, and chemical trades.

documents.document_name: PAN Card & Aadhaar Card of Employer / Proprietor
documents.description: Taxation and identity proof of the employer or managing director.

documents.document_name: Commercial Address Proof (Electricity Bill / Rent Agreement)
documents.description: Electricity bill of establishment premises not older than 3 months, along with registered lease deed.

documents.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Partnership Deed
documents.description: RoC certificate of incorporation or registered partnership deed establishing legal business entity.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for Companies, LLPs, and Registered Partnership Firms.

documents.document_name: List of Employees with Designation and Wages
documents.description: Register detailing names, age, dates of appointment, and monthly wages of all employed staff.

documents.document_name: Photograph of Establishment Displaying Bilingual Name Board
documents.description: Frontal photograph of establishment entrance clearly displaying commercial name board in local state language and English.

documents.document_name: PAN Card of Enterprise / Professional

documents.document_name: Professional Qualification / Certificate of Practice
documents.description: Registration certificate from Bar Council (Lawyers), Medical Council (Doctors), ICAI (CA), or Council of Architecture.

documents.document_name: Proof of Place of Work / Business Premises Address
documents.description: Utility bill, property tax receipt, or lease agreement of office chamber or consulting room.

documents.document_name: Bank Account Statement / Cancelled Cheque
documents.description: Bank passbook or cancelled cheque displaying business/professional account title and IFSC code.

documents.document_name: Shop & Establishment Certificate or GSTIN
documents.description: Statutory trade registration certificate.
documents.condition_rule: Required if applicant runs an incorporated commercial or consultancy office.

documents.description: Detailed architectural drawings showing machine positioning, clear gangways, fire escapes, and natural ventilation.

documents.document_name: Land Title Deed / Industrial Estate Allotment Order
documents.description: Registered title deed or State Small Industries Development Corporation allotment order for factory plot.

documents.document_name: List of Plant and Machinery with Horsepower (HP) Rating
documents.description: Certified schedule detailing each production machine, individual motor capacity in HP, and total connected load in KVA.

documents.document_name: State Pollution Control Board Consent to Establish (CTE)
documents.description: Statutory environmental consent order issued under Air and Water Pollution Control Acts.

documents.document_name: Emergency Preparedness & On-Site Disaster Management Plan
documents.description: Documented disaster response plan and hazardous chemical storage protocols.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for chemical, pharmaceutical, metallurgical, or hazardous process factory operations.

documents.document_name: Photo ID of Food Business Operator (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID)

documents.description: Document establishing physical address where food preparation, processing, or storage occurs.

documents.description: Declaration or certified FSMS plan outlining hygienic handling, pest control, and food safety protocols.

documents.document_name: List of Food Product Categories & Manufacturing Flowchart
documents.description: Complete list of food items manufactured, repacked, or sold with production flow steps.

documents.document_name: Water Testing Analysis Report from NABL-Accredited Lab
documents.description: Chemical and microbiological potability report of water used in food preparation.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for food manufacturers, beverage bottlers, restaurants, and catering establishments.

documents.document_name: Medical Fitness Certificates of Food Handlers
documents.description: Medical examination reports certifying workers are free from communicable diseases and vaccinated against typhoid.
documents.condition_rule: Mandatory for commercial kitchens, catering units, and packaged food manufacturing plants.

documents.document_name: PAN Card of Business Entity / Proprietor
documents.description: Permanent Account Number of proprietor (for proprietorship) or company/firm PAN (for legal entities).

documents.description: Cancelled cheque or bank statement showing business name, account number, and IFSC code.

documents.document_name: Partnership Deed / RoC Certificate of Incorporation
documents.description: Legal charter document establishing partnership firm, LLP, or private limited company.

documents.document_name: Board Resolution / Letter of Authorization for Signatory
documents.description: Formal resolution or authorization letter appointing the authorized tax signatory.

documents.document_name: 12-Digit Universal Account Number (UAN)

documents.document_name: Aadhaar Card (Linked with UAN & Active Mobile for OTP)
documents.description: Aadhaar card seeded with UAN enabling paperless OTP authentication for claims.

documents.document_name: Joint Declaration Form signed by Employer and Employee

documents.description: Bank account verification details of employer entity.
